text: Nice app to archive your trees ... and helps with dates of fertilisation and pruning. I would love a bit more tailored detailed with current weather...region in the world etc.

I'm reasonably experienced but to be able to keep track of my trees in such detail is remarkable. The tips are extremely useful to refresh one's memory regarding all things bonsai. Highly recommended.

really handy app for keeping track of all the little things which need remember with Bonsai. you can upload photos, add notes about development etc... so all in all a lot less bother than trying to do it manually in onenote or something similar. can definitely recommend especially as the Devs seem to listen to suggestions for functionalality improvements. To get the one extra star, I would want this to also work under windows so it is truly platform agnostic. Something for the future maybe.
love this application.
Love this app. Not sure how my husband and I would keep track of all our trees if we didn't have it. Lol, we would still be fighting over who's trees were who's.

I like this app because it helps me to organize my trees and to develop a care plan for them. I like the ability to document their progress with photos. I hope that the developers will continue to add more tree species in the future.
very useful and user friendly, it has helped me greatly.
So far it is good it gives you the notification when needed. I have a place finally to keep track of what as been done with each tree. plus I can then have pictures of the trees progress.

A great way of keeping you aware of what needs doing and when,I've been keeping bonsai now for just over forty years and one famous bonsai professional said to me don't spread yourself too thin the trees will suffer,but I did they did for a long time,don't we all collect too many,so I'm using this app to get back on track,we all need a nudge from time to time.well worth having.
a very useful tool to have reminding me to carry out important tasks on my trees.

great app. I pay the monthly subscription and it's much easier than keeping a spreadsheet of my trees. the photo upload option is great for tracking progress and the tree specific advice is comprehensive. only sticking point for me is the default option is to publicly share a new tree so I have to remember to turn that off

I've been absolutely passionate about the art of bonsai for over 40 years, so I know a thing or two about it. So, I just recently downloaded what I consider to be the top two bonsai care/collection apps anywhere out there... BONSAI CARE APP and APPY-BONSAI. At this point they're both great (I'm using the paid versions of both.) however, as time goes on, I'll definitely figure out which one takes the gold 🥇 once and for all. I'll keep you posted!!! GREAT JOB DEVS!!!!!
The perfect app to make sure all of my trees are well taken care of

It's an extremely helpful app with tons of information and videos. It keeps you on your game, accountable and aware of the joy it brings. I have already recommended it and will continue to do so! I pay yearly, I believe in this app. So worth it. Courses to come soon!
So love the app, if you're into bonsai you will too. I think it took all of 10 minutes in before I purchased the pro version. Good job guys!
This app is great, that's exactly what I need and has a low-cost premium that expands your usage capabilities if you are serious about your birthday practice and have a large collection of trees.

this is brilliant. the app reminds me when to water and care for my trees being a beginner its brilliant in case I miss something important bonssai are nit cheep this stops me from unalivinv mh plants .
keeps your bonsai routine up to date use as assistant to support your daily checks ☺️✅
Excellent!
just loaded my first 2 trees. this app is amazing.

Have had the app for about 2 weeks now. Input all the info for one of my trees to see how the app works and set up reminders. Days, weeks go by with no notifications from this app--then suddenly tonight I get 5 notifications all at once to water my chinese elm.

I've only been growing Bonsai for a couple of years and this app is the best help I've had. it's doubled my knowledge and enjoyment. It's so easy to use and the information on it is fantastic, for a beginner it answers all those questio ns that everyone else takes for granted. Well Done Guys 👏 I'm loving the App.
great app by a small team, upgraded to pro so I can load all of my trees !!

Great app, well worth the pro version. I really like the care tips per tree, a n00b like me really needs that! the social features are very nice, too. So much inspiration! Would be awesome to also be able to follow people, or make friends, with a separate timeline or something.
once set up it's super nice. lots of information
An absolutely fantastic app and a perfect way for tracking your bonsai collection through photos, reminders, and notes. All that and in-depth species guides for a huge variety of trees.

Loving the app. I have had it for a while and with spring here have upgraded to the pro version. I am enjoying seeing other people's trees and can see it as a real community for sharing of tips and information. one thing: it would be great to configure views in the social section, for example: sort by most recent etc. I have another idea for you: how about a section for 'inspiration from nature', I.e. photos of full size (or dwarfed!) trees or shrubs that could be an inspiration for bonsai.
This is a really good app. You can have 5 bonsai and 5 photos.

I would 100% Move my collection to this beautifully convenient app if the following 4 features were present: 1. collection filtering or sorting: (having all my trees accessible through different filters. For example, all shohin pines in the Mid development stage not in plastic pot) 2. custom fields we could add (for example if the tree is on loan or not) 3. Data export with images. 4. web app version, accessible through any browser.
Hope to use this app for 40 years
Too rich to my blood
enjoy this app for care and maintenance of my first bonsai tree

I'm finding this app extremely helpful. Definitely recommend.
Easy to use, lots of helpful info and reminders. This is a great way to keep track and care for your trees (especially for novice Bonsai owners).
Very impressive on the phone - but it would be great if I could use it on the PC too. Any plans for that?
Great little app for keeping track of my plants and when major steps were last taken.

I've just downloaded this after seeing Bjorn's video. It looks great and I can't wait to get stuck into it. One feature I'd love to see in the Pro version is if you could transfer trees to other people, so when you sell it, you can take it's past with you and also how it has been cared for (giving you a great guide on how to keep it going). Just an idea for you to think of
Great app. The support team are also very helpful.
Great app. Lots of features to track stuff I've been pretending to remember.

Uninstalled the very first morning because the notifications are unswipeable. I haven't found any settings to change it. I also saw the very limited library and the paywall and knew I would only ever truly benefit from the reminders and having a list of my trees, both things that can be easily done without the app. I do not recommend it to anyone, beginner or professional. It's much more convenient to just use the phone's notes and alarms. Google has care info and guides. The app doesn't.

Hi, I'm a yearly subscriber to the bonsai care app and I am loving everything about it, particularly the usability and using the reminders. I would love to be able to add many more species of trees that are not listed when selecting a species. Thankyou for reading my feedback.

This is a MUST app for all bonsai owners. I'm really quite impressed with this app. The wealth of information for free in this app is simply amazing. The best part of the app is when you add a tree, it tailors the information for your specific tree and helps you care for it.
Great app for any serious bonsai lovers out there!
So far exactly what I wanted in such type of app. I'll update my update my review in few month of use...

I haven't had the app long, but as soon as I finished my three tree test, I was read to sign up for my first year. And, I did! As I complete each tree's spring work, into the app it goes. And, it's easy to add my own oddball species to the extensive database. The information about each species is, likewise, extensive. And, I keep learning more about the app's options. In short, I love the app. It's incredibly helpful in organizing all that I do with my bonsai.
This is a very good app
This is just wat I was looking for! Excellent 👍
Loving the App so far, information is really fantastic, everything you need for successful bonsai

The app has a lot of potential but is all over the place with its scheduling. I added all my trees last week and, for interest, added one of my Bougainvilleas again today to see if the app is consistent, but it wasn't at all. The dates were completely different for the exact same plant. Even worse, the watering schedule doesn't change no matter what species of tree you put in.
Over priced just to have more trees jn your collection...
Excellent little app to help me organize my Bonsai.

Like the app. Easy to use, although I live in the southern hemisphere, and the upcoming reminders have the incorrect season details. Can not find any way to change that even though I have changed it in settings. Add on, Thanks to the great team, it is cured. For Southern Hemisphere set that in options BEFORE putting your trees in. Great app. Thanks
Just downloaded the app and it appears to perfect to catalogue your bonsais AND send you reminders for regular tasks you may forget.
Nicee, but some of the subtropical region plants aren't there
Not showing banyan tree
I'm very hopeful for this app, missing a few things that would be useful but great start.
This is EXACTLY what I needed to track my trees while working a full time job.

Personally I find it a bit basic and rushed. There are so many aspects of the app that many other plant apps can also do. I also find it to be odd in the timing of its release, almost to try and get out there "first". It's very rudimentary and not really an app I think I'll use. Not much that sets its apart from other notification based apps to be honest. Just my opinion though
Really well put together , it's great to have a place to put all the trees and scheduled maintenance of them
Wonderful tool to keep track of my newly obtained bonsai trees for the holidays. Very extensive but easy to use.

Helpful App - I only have one tree at present. The app seems to have lots of useful info regarding the care and maintenance of my Jade tree. I started setting up reminders for care, which is a nice feature. Still exploring, but so far, this is a useful app.

This is a good app with some interesting functions. This is excellent for beginners, but it is still useful for those of us who are more advanced. It is a great way to simply track your trees if you dont need the reminders or care information. Nice Job.
I'm from nepal 🇳🇵. This app make very easy to take care of our bonsai..
Nice app!
Professional looking app. Lots of info.

Aplicação super completa com possibilidade de registo de inúmeros detalhes. Super intuitiva e com um design de elevado nível.

Love the apps. Easier for me to track my bonsai progress. Subscription is also not too expensive
So far, I'm loving this app!!! It's packed with features and is perfect for keeping accurate records of my constantly changing and/or growing collection of bonsai. Great work developers!!!
I was not able to log in via google.

I have been a serious Bonsai artist and collector for over 40 years. in my opinion, Appy Bonsai is an extremely valuable tool for keeping detailed records of my entire bonsai collection, including my bonsai pots, tools, and even suiseki rocks and kusamono (accent plants). I have absolutely nothing bad to say about this app. it's really wonderful!!! I think every bonsai enthusiast, beginner or grand master, should use it to keep track of their bonsai collection. Keep up the amazing work guys!

Great idea, looks really good and plenty of subjects. You can manage bonsai, pots, tools and even rocks/suiseki. Only downpoint for me is that when selecting pictures, you can only choose camera roll, screenshots or downloads. There is option to use the cloud, but i havent got it. I have messaged the maker, but they say its down to my phone permissions. I now use YAMA BONSAI app. Its a bit different but i do have the option to add multiple pictures from all my albums on my phone.

A funcionalidade do app é excelente, ajuda muito no dia a dia. Mas ultimamente tem apresetado muitos problemas. Mesmo a com atualização do dia 19/04/2026 continua sem reconher assinatura Premium. É complicado pois utilizo o app pra registrar minha rotina de cuidados e informações importantes dos meus Bonsai

Great app! I've tried many before picking this one! It would be great to have: A list of your trees (w/o pictures, fast to scroll) and the possibility of adding new species. Thank you very much!

Great App. I'm glad I have something practical to record my progress each day. It's a great platform for the Bonsai community. However, I am having issues writing my updates with the app being temperamental. This is an issue that has just occurred. It will not allow me to type in comment section and the picture that shows progress does not always show up. Overall, I think it's a great app and has great potential. It's good that this was invented.

Thanks for this app! I have recently been thinking on developing something like that, and I'm glad I just found your work. I would love to help you further developing this app and encourage the bonsai community around me to use it. Also, it would be awesome to have a functionality for batch uploading/downloading plant progress. Or even a RESTful API for devs. Thanks again!

Im rewriting this review after issue got fixed by devs. With this app, tracking bonsai progress became very simple and lot easier. And the timeline feature is lit 🔥. Also lots of bonsai collections appear on homefeed, very interesting app must to have for both beginners and experienced bonsai lovers and collectors.
The app is great, just what I needed to record my progress on all my trees. The app is super easy to use and it seems like there's updates coming through all the time.
Fantastic app for tracking your bonsai progress! Exactly what I was looking for

Cool APP to keep track of bonsai. However, it keeps crashing. I'm in the progress of putting all my bonsai updates for this year and I can't do that for more than 10min. After that it crashes. It crashes in the process of browsing for photos and uploading them. Only after a few minutes I can open the app again and add more entries. I see good potential, if these kinds of things get fixed in future updates. Running version 2.0.2, crashes almost every time I try to upload photos from GooglePhotos
